title: Mughal Economy Trend Of Indias Economy In First Half Of 18th Century
definition: A period of transition characterized by the systemic decline of the centralized Mughal fiscal apparatus (Jagirdari crisis) and the emergence of regional successor states, leading to a shift from a centralized imperial economy to decentralized, localized agrarian and commercial networks.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Transition Period' between Medieval and Modern India; frequently tested in the context of the 'Crisis of the 18th Century' debate (Irfan Habib vs. M.N. Pearson).
